text: - By invocation: a build that resolves the whole workspace (`cargo test --workspace`, `ci-leg.sh fast`, CI's test leg) turns `blitz-dom/tracing` on — blitz's default `tracing` reaches blitz-shell and blitz-html, and each of those forwards to blitz-dom — while `cargo test -p blitz-tests` and a `-p seven_guis` build leave it off; so under the workspace build a test child that installs escher's sink at `info` also receives engine events: one `INFO blitz_dom::document … message=[redacted]` beside a driver `type` (packages/blitz-shell/Cargo.toml:21; packages/blitz-html/Cargo.toml:15; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1902; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/evidence/feature-unification.md, from cargo's resolved feature graph, the event at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-driver-command-spans/report.md; test-plan §9 → Engine features by runner). Measured at 2026-10-10-driver-cli for the session host: on a snapshot · click · type flow the workspace-built `escher-session` host prints that one engine line, `blitz_dom::document` at INFO, from `info` up and no further line at `debug` or `trace`, and the host built alone (`-p seven_guis`) prints none (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-driver-cli/evidence/by-level.md); re-measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep on the same flow, the workspace-built host prints that engine line twice from `info` up — `trace` adding no line — and the host built alone still none (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/evidence/log-counts.md).
